name: nearhood-backend-v2
description: Ultra-fast backend with Cloudflare D1 SQL, R2 per-user folder storage, and Render Node support

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute nearhood-d1 --local --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute nearhood-d1 --local --file=./migrations/0002_feed_post_attributes.sql
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 execute nearhood-d1 --remote --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute nearhood-d1 --remote --file=./migrations/0002_feed_post_attributes.sql
